title: Common Questions
body: Everything you need to know about our platform.

trial.question: How does the free trial work?
trial.answer: Start with a 14-day free trial with full access to all features. No credit card required.

changePlan.question: Can I change my plan later?
changePlan.answer: Yes, you can upgrade or downgrade your plan at any time. Changes take effect immediately.

payment.question: What payment methods do you accept?
payment.answer: We accept all major credit cards, PayPal, and bank transfers for annual plans.

setupFee.question: Is there a setup fee?
setupFee.answer: No, there are no setup fees or hidden costs. You only pay for your subscription plan.

refunds.question: Do you offer refunds?
refunds.answer: We offer a 30-day money-back guarantee. Contact us within 30 days for a full refund.

cancel.question: How do I cancel my subscription?
cancel.answer: You can cancel anytime from your account settings. Your access continues until the billing period ends.
